current_goal.goal: Keep the released 0.1.18 Provider Source panel unchanged while adding bilingual, per-model horizontal request settings to saved Volcengine Ark and Agent Plan model edit dialogs.
non_goals: Do not redesign or extend the 0.1.18 Provider Source panel.
Do not modify AstrBot modalities or claim model capability from request settings.
Do not leak Volcengine fields into foreign provider model cards.
Do not invent a generic Thinking Budget field without a verified Ark mapping.
Do not merge or publish 0.1.19 without explicit user approval and the post-merge publication gates.
success_conditions: Saved Ark and Agent Plan model edit dialogs expose the approved bilingual rows.
Foreign provider model dialogs expose none of the Volcengine 0.1.19 fields.
Explicit horizontal values override the same custom_extra_body request keys; empty values inject nothing.
Video mode supports Off, Compressed, and Original while preserving 0.1.18 Boolean compatibility.
AstrBot 4.26.1 and 4.27.2 packaged runtime contracts pass.
Real AstrBot Dashboard presentation evidence passes without changing the 0.1.18 Source UI contract.

frozen_constraints: AstrBot owns provider lifecycle, routing, fallback, retry, model-card management, metadata display, and shared Dashboard rendering.
The 0.1.18 Source-level volcengine_video_controls_visible value is presentation state only; per-card volcengine_video_input_enabled remains the Source shortcut/runtime Boolean authority.
The shared top capability/modalities area is not a safe provider-specific extension surface for the fifth video capability control.
Ordinary model-edit body rows can be safely projected only onto owned saved model-card copies; this is narrower than the rejected generic capability-row extension.
Request settings are transport/configuration, not permanent model capability facts.
Missing feedback is not false; interaction is not judgment.
Historical QQ media evidence remains valid only within its premises and must be revalidated when REGRESSION_SCOPE invalidators fire.
Development documentation and evidence stay outside the allow-list runtime package.

current_strategy.model_ui: project bilingual horizontal rows only onto owned saved Ark and Agent Plan model-card copies
